meta.stems: work/stems/ (separated from this file: BS-RoFormer vocals, htdemucs_ft drums/bass/other, mel-band-roformer karaoke lead/backing). The supplied spliced stems are a different render (44.1 kHz, 236.40 s, offset drifting 0 -> +2 s) and were not used for timing.
meta.tempo_note: Measured ~136-140 BPM (not 150). Beats: beat_this + snap to drum onsets; cut to beats[], not to a constant tempo.

sections.name: intro
sections.description: Solo guqin (0-2.0), low hand-drum pulse from 2.03, bright clapper 16ths from ~12.6 tightening to a 32nd roll 15.07-15.28; wordless vocal hum (D4) 13.3-15.3; 75 ms full-band hole 15.440-15.515.

sections.name: verse1
sections.description: Band + bass enter after the hole; child "妈妈..." from 15.81, Mom from 23.06; steady 16th percussion (no audible slow-to-fast clapper accelerando); drums drop out 37.885-40.995 under "soaking up light" (the [Pause]).

sections.name: prechorus
sections.description: Drums back on the 41.014 downbeat; "It split apart" with a 3-hole stutter chop 43.80-44.13 and drum break 44.15-44.50; "Monkey!" 45.275; drums thin to a 16th-note roll 57.04-57.81, then a drum break under the "Born fully formed" pickup (57.79).

sections.name: hook1
sections.description: The stone bursts: crash + kick on the 58.673 downbeat into breakbeat; octave duet; vocals end 73.5; 72.0-85.2 instrumental post-hook (suona-like lead in the other stem, drum breaks 71.9-72.8 and 75.5-76.4).

sections.name: verse2_memory
sections.description: Fill 85.46-86.12 (IOI 219->44 ms) into a bass/band hole 85.99-87.0, band back with crash 86.998; Mom/child verse; band drops away 100.9-107.9 for "The master leaned in close" with isolated hits; audible whispered "ps ps ps" 103.20-103.60 over hits at 103.207/103.416/103.648.

sections.name: rap
sections.description: Crash + full breakbeat on 107.975 (rap pickup from 107.04); fast Mandarin rap, Mom joins (octave double) from 112.76; inline echoes "七十二变" (110.38) and "谁是真身" (119.54).

sections.name: verse3_band
sections.description: Headband verse: instrumental narrows (L/R corr ~0.95, width close 121.905) and low-passes (>4 kHz share -35..-55 dB, filter close 122.545) with sparse hits; reopens: filter 135.685, width 136.025, full band back on the 135.878 downbeat; drums drop out 146.455 under "no more, no less".

sections.name: yes
sections.description: Child "Yes" (148.72-149.27), off the beat over the drum-less tail.

sections.name: silence
sections.description: Only near-silence in the song: mix < -50 dBFS 149.285-149.525 (0.24 s), then a crash/sub hit at 149.720. Not a full bar (bar = 1.73 s).

sections.name: bridge
sections.description: Full band with drums and a sustained suona-like line from 149.72 (NOT drum-less); child sings alone 162.63-176.1; no clearly audible vocoder (not measurable).

sections.name: build
sections.description: Drums and bass drop out (177.645); sparse low tonal drum hits 179.094, 180.758, 184.121, 187.460 (+187.781, 188.097, 188.313); Mom/child dialogue ("Wouldn't you? You're able" ends 189.9 over the drop).

sections.name: drop2
sections.description: Arrives as a 4-hit stuttered crash 189.805/189.867/189.922/189.972 (drums back), then kick + bass on the 190.860 downbeat (grid beat 190.885); octave duet with chopped echoes; stutter chop 200.675-201.080 inside "一通百通".

sections.name: outro
sections.description: Mom "Do you want to know..." over the beat; bass cuts 211.515 (downbeat); the beat cuts out mid-bar at 218.715 (one beat after the 218.332 downbeat); child lines over pads with two isolated wooden/low hits 221.805, 225.254.

sections.name: end
sections.description: Percussion pattern returns (16ths) 228.767-235.833 with the last vocal note ("line") to 230.76; sub drone in 232.29; last hit 235.833; drone/hum cuts 237.84; faint -43 dBFS tail; file hard-cuts at 238.320 (no digital silence).
